title: disposable corn cob holders
text: disposable corn cob holders. Got these for a seafood boil we were doing for the littler ones to use.  They worked perfectly, easy to insert quickly and toss with the cob.  No more digging through the garbage to find the reusable ones that got tossed by accident.  They are wood so they are biodegradable.  I would buy them again.
